data.name: Wall Escaper: Stream Sabotage
data.detailed_description:
Going Live? Now It’s Your Viewers’ Turn to Torment You!

Wall Escaper: Stream Sabotage is a real-time, viewer-interactive survival game that connects to TikTok LIVE.

Dodge obstacles on precarious platforms, endure attacks coming from every direction, and somehow survive until the timer finally reaches zero.

Avoiding every fall would be ideal, of course—but falling is nothing unusual in this game. Get back up, start running again, get knocked off again, and keep going. That is simply part of the job.

Enter the username of a TikTok account that is currently live, and viewer gifts and interactions will become in-game events. Some viewers may summon obstacles to get in your way, while others may add more time just when you thought the match was finally about to end.

You have only one objective:

Survive until it ends. Assuming it ever does.

Gameplay

The player must endure a timed challenge on a dangerous course suspended high in the air.

Dodge moving obstacles, cross narrow platforms, and respond to disruptions triggered in real time by TikTok viewers. Even if a powerful impact sends you falling into the void, the match continues. Return to the course and keep surviving for whatever time remains.

The host can customize both the number of matches and the time limit for each one. Use the default settings, create a quick challenge for a shorter stream, or prepare for a much longer endurance session.

Do not relax just because the timer is almost empty.

A single viewer gift can add more time, turning a match that was nearly over into a challenge that lasts for hours.

Features

Once your TikTok LIVE begins, prepare for the following:

Connect to TikTok LIVE

Enter the username of a TikTok account that is currently live to connect the broadcast to the game.

There is no need to manually enter complicated server information. Simply connect the live account and receive viewer interactions directly inside the game.

Survive Viewer Sabotage

Viewers can use TikTok gifts to trigger a variety of in-game events.

They can knock the player away with powerful impacts, summon new obstacles onto the course, or extend the timer to keep the match going even longer.

A location that seemed safe only moments ago can become dangerous with a single viewer’s decision.

Customize Gift Effects

The host can decide which TikTok gifts trigger which in-game effects.

Create anything from harmless distractions to devastating sabotage, and configure the events to suit the size, mood, and audience of your stream.

Adjust the Match Rules

The host can customize the number of matches and the time limit for each match.

Use the default settings, create a short and fast challenge, or configure a long survival session that continues for as long as your viewers are willing to keep it alive.

A Reward for Falling… Maybe?

The host can enable an option that adds another match after the player falls a certain number of times.

Use the default fall requirement, choose a different number, or disable the feature entirely. Reaching 100 falls just as the end comes into sight—only to discover that another match has been added—is entirely up to the host.

The Brainrot Invasion

Brainrot characters may appear during the broadcast to torment the player.

Keep moving, endure their unpredictable interference, and try not to get knocked off the course. Your viewers may enjoy watching you suffer far more than watching you survive.

A Timer That Refuses to End

A match ends when its timer finally reaches zero.

However, viewers can continue adding more time. A match that begins with ten minutes could last one hour, three hours, or even longer.

By the end of the stream, it may be your viewers—not the host—who decide when the game is allowed to finish.

What’s Included in Wall Escaper: Stream Sabotage

  • Timed obstacle-survival gameplay

  • Easy connection using the username of a TikTok account that is currently live

  • Customizable links between TikTok gifts and in-game events

  • Powerful impact effects that knock the player away

  • A variety of obstacles that can be summoned onto the course

  • Brainrot characters that appear to torment the player

  • Adjustable match count and time limits

  • Customizable fall requirements and optional bonus matches

  • Game rules that hosts can configure to suit their own streaming style

You do not even have to play it yourself.

Recommend this game to a TikTok host you would love to torment.

data.short_description: A survival action game made for streamers, where viewer gifts turn into unpredictable sabotage. Dodge relentless walls and dangerous obstacles, and survive the chaos until the timer runs out!
